gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-fs-fira-sans: Refined and authoritative, Noto Serif Gujarati keeps its stroke weights moderate up top. And Fira Sans follows with a large x-height and curves that open wide, with no thick-thin shift at all.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-fs-public-san: Oversized lowercase bodies give Noto Serif Gujarati a distinctive presence, with only a mild taper where strokes turn. Public Sans below is hefty and broad-countered, so paragraphs feel sturdy and unhurried.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-fs-supreme: Refined is the first impression from Noto Serif Gujarati, whose strokes vary softly in thickness. Supreme works differently, laying down a crisp, heavy-looking band of plain sans text with letters held open.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-general-sans: General Sans reads smooth and generous, its tall x-height filling the line and every bend left unobstructed. Beside Noto Serif Gujarati's gentle stroke modulation, that pipe-cleaner simplicity is the pair's sharpest edge.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-manrope: Warm serif up top, tidy rods below. Noto Serif Gujarati carries subtle, visible stroke modulation, while Manrope sets every horizontal and vertical at identical thickness, and that sharp divide is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-montserrat: Modest curves above, wiry geometry below. Noto Serif Gujarati earns its keep in big, short lines, where its stress shows, while Montserrat glides under the eye as a sans-serif cut from one gauge.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-satoshi: Noto Serif Gujarati swells faintly in each curve, like pulled taffy. Satoshi, a plain sans with a soaring x-height, holds one line width throughout, and that gap between swell and sameness is what defines the pair.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-switzer: Refined lettering leads here, with Noto Serif Gujarati modulating calmly so nothing snags the eye. Switzer then glides along like wire, a sans-serif with a tall waist line and c tips that never crowd.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-work-sans: Noto Serif Gujarati lays down a subtle thick-and-thin cadence, oversized in its lowercase and quietly authoritative. Work Sans runs flat and unswelling along each curve, so a longer read moves briskly and cleanly.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gurmukhi-archivo: Noto Serif Gurmukhi has a bookish, traditional feel, with middling thick-thin variation and capitals nearly level with its lowercase. Archivo, a plain sans with a commanding x-height, opens its curves outward beside it.
